Each fixed semantic ID is attached once to its real node, and note IDs are generated from unique enumeration indices; no duplicate proxy is constructed.
The status identifier is on the real padded painted container, whose actual background is the state fill.
The statusText identifier is attached directly to the displayed status Text, with no geometry proxy.
The full component body uses vertical layout containers and text/buttons; no scroll container is introduced.
The complete body has content spacing, ordinary padding and the visible ink accent; there is no blank spacer row manufacturing content height.
The supplied notes collection is enumerated directly in caller order, with heading then body for each note.
The full production implementation branches on supplied guard Booleans and local interaction state, and keys reset by model ID; no fixture/scenario/test-value special cases appear.
The eligible request path forwards transfer.id from the current supplied model.
All business callback invocation sites are inside guarded native user-action paths; construction, rendering and identity replacement do not invoke them.
Disclosure only toggles handlingOpen and invokes no caller callback.
The primary is natively disabled outside the eligibility predicate and its action independently rechecks that predicate before callback.
The confirmation is natively disabled after requested and its action independently guards requested before toggling/callback.
All declared text sites configure no finite line cap; Swift applies lineLimit(nil), and Compose Text calls omit maxLines and retain unlimited defaults.
The native primary control/label explicitly fills available width and a 56-unit high allocation; the Android label fills the control size and centers vertically.

The primary uses a full rectangular activation shape matching its configured allocation: Swift contentShape(Rectangle()) on the full-width 56-high label, Compose native Button with RectangleShape and full-sized label.

The enabled predicate contains exactly sealIntact, coolantReady, acknowledged, and negated requested combined with conjunction.
The status conditional explicitly checks broken seal, unavailable coolant, requested, acknowledged, then awaiting, in that order.
The successful guarded confirmation action flips the current acknowledgement Boolean.
The confirmation action invokes its callback with the Boolean after toggling.
There is exactly one acknowledgement callback invocation in the successful guarded toggle action.
The eligible release action sets requested to true before invoking the request callback.
The eligible guarded release path contains exactly one onRelease invocation.
Inspection of the full component shows only local presentation/state and supplied callbacks; it starts no freezer/hardware/physical transfer operation.
